components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact red command button for primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #CC0000; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 0 12px; font: 700 13px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #990000; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(204, 0, 0, 0.22); }

components.name: Segmented Range Control
components.description: Compact time-range control like the director dashboard reference.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; background: #DDE2E8; padding: 4px; } .ds-segmented button { height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #4B5563; padding: 0 14px; font: 700 12px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-segmented button:hover { background: #EEF1F4; color: #111827; } .ds-segmented .is-active { background: #CC0000; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(204, 0, 0, 0.22); }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: White KPI panel with oversized executive metric.
components.css: .ds-metric-card { width: 320px; border: 1px solid #DDE2E8; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111827; padding: 22px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06); } .ds-metric-card .ds-label { margin: 0 0 14px; color: #8A95A3; font: 800 11px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-metric-card strong { display: block; margin: 0 0 12px; color: #111827; font: 900 48px/0.95 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-metric-card div { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-metric-card span { border-radius: 999px; background: #DCFCE7; color: #166534; padding: 4px 8px; font: 800 11px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-metric-card small { color: #8A95A3; font: 700 11px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }

components.name: Strategic Alert Panel
components.description: Dark operational risk surface for strategic alerts only.
components.html:
Strategic Alerts

Pipeline on trackNo stale deals detected this period

components.css: .ds-alert-panel { width: 320px; border-radius: 12px; background: #0F172A; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 20px; } .ds-alert-panel > p { margin: 0 0 18px; color: #DDE2E8; font: 800 12px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-alert { border-left: 4px solid #DDE2E8; padding: 0 0 0 12px; margin: 14px 0; } .ds-alert.is-red { border-left-color: #CC0000; } .ds-alert.is-blue { border-left-color: #3B82F6; } .ds-alert strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font: 800 13px/1.2 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-alert span { display: block; color: #8A95A3; font: 500 11px/1.3 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Standard Input
components.description: Compact field for filters, forms, and admin operations.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 260px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid #DDE2E8; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111827; padding: 0 10px; font: 500 14px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8A95A3; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #CC0000; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(204, 0, 0, 0.22); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Small operational label for counts, risk, and status.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(204, 0, 0, 0.22); border-radius: 4px; background: #FEE2E2; color: #CC0000; padding: 0 8px; font: 800 11px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; text-transform: lowercase; }

components.name: Executive Table
components.description: Dense table pattern for rep, deal, and pipeline performance.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111827; font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-table th { height: 42px; border-bottom: 1px solid #EEF1F4; color: #4B5563; text-align: left; font: 800 11px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-table td { height: 64px; border-bottom: 1px solid #EEF1F4; font: 700 14px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-table tr:hover td { background: #F5F6F8; } .ds-table .ds-avatar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; margin-right: 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: #CC0000; color: #FFFFFF; font: 900 12px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: T Rock CRM should feel like an executive operations board for a construction company: direct, compact, numerically confident, and built for repeated daily work. The director dashboard screenshot is the strongest current reference: hard-working typography, red as the command signal, pale industrial surfaces, compact time controls, and dark alert panels that separate operational risk from routine data.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, scan-first information layout with clear table and list hierarchy.
Heavy executive typography for major metrics and page titles.
Brand red used for action, identity, urgency, and selected states.
Pale concrete backgrounds with white content panels and steel borders.
Dark navy surfaces reserved for navigation, alerts, and operational command areas.

rules.name: The Red Has A Job Rule
rules.body: Red marks command, identity, selection, or risk. Do not use it as decorative trim.

rules.name: The Pale Shop Floor Rule
rules.body: Main work surfaces stay pale and clear. Use white panels on a light field background, with steel borders doing most of the separation.

rules.name: The Dark Alert Rule
rules.body: Dark navy belongs to the sidebar and strategic alert zones. Do not convert normal data cards into dark cards.

rules.name: The Numbers Lead Rule
rules.body: Metrics use oversized weight and tight line-height. Labels explain them after the number, not before it.

rules.name: The Border First Rule
rules.body: Reach for steel borders and tonal panels before shadows.

dos: Do use the director dashboard screenshot as the target density and tone for executive surfaces.
Do keep T Rock Red reserved for command, identity, selection, and risk.
Do use tables, compact lists, and KPI bands before decorative card grids.
Do make dashboard numbers bold enough to read in a glance.
Do use Lucide icons with consistent stroke weight inside compact controls.
Do keep the dark navy sidebar and alert panels visually separate from normal white data panels.
donts: Don't make the CRM look like generic SaaS / HubSpot templates.
Don't use overly playful / startup aesthetics, rounded everything, emoji, or toy-like controls.
Don't create enterprise bloat with cluttered dashboards and tiny unreadable text.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or generic shadcn purple defaults.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored side stripe on cards, list items, callouts, or alerts.
Don't turn red into background decoration. If everything is red, nothing is urgent.
